issues.observed: The official Android TV API26 image provides WebView 58.0.3029.125; static ES modules are unavailable and the JS plugin initialization previously waited until timeout.
issues.change: Read the actual provider version on the UI thread before constructing the plugin WebView. Unknown versions and Chromium below 61 fail immediately with a specific update message; JAR and Python remain independent.
issues.verification: Six provider gate assertions passed. Native error and modern-provider execution are separate pending instrumentation checks.

issues.observed: Two r4 installation clients timed out. Inspection found an unsealed installation session; the installed application still pointed to the preceding candidate.
issues.change: Abandon the identified pending session using the platform package command, then cold-start the same dedicated AVD with its userdata and SSE4.1/SSE4.2 CPU flags preserved. Do not uninstall the application or treat a client timeout as completed installation.
issues.verification: Boot and package service returned; final APK installation and instrumentation remain separate checks.

issues.observed: The emulator advanced its media clock much slower than a fixed wall-clock sleep. A fixed 1.2-second wait would mix functional playback correctness with emulated performance.
issues.change: Keep a bounded 45-second wait for at least 250ms of actual playback progression, require playing state, and record actual wall-clock and media-clock deltas. Decoded SurfaceView pixels are still required.
issues.verification: No claim of real-device speed or smooth playback follows from this test.

issues.observed: The first isolated fixture compiler omitted the production ABI okhttp3 dependency and failed at Spider.safeDns.
issues.change: Use the existing pinned NAS/dependency classpath for the fixture compilation; production plugin code was not changed.
issues.verification: The separate synthetic plugin fixture starts on loopback port 4401; end-to-end native playback evidence follows independently.
